none: PAS NLM-982D80: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bullnecked bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS [---]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA] EXERC [I]TVS. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 15.8mm, Weight: 1.63gms, die axis: 12
